title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: In the makerspace assistant's loop, the model asks for check_calendar in call 1. In call 2 it uses the calendar result to write its answer. How does call 2 have the result?

options.text: The model kept the result in its own memory after call 1
The API stores the model's state and resumes it in call 2
The program put the request and result into call 2's input
The calendar tool sends the result straight to the model

items.stem: Your assistant's system prompt, tool definitions and the student's question total 2,000 tokens. In call 1 the model writes a 50-token tool request. The tool result is 500 tokens. Call 2 writes the final answer. Counting only input tokens read by the model, how many tokens are read across the two calls in total?
A student who finished laser cutter training last month returns and asks to book it. Which design lets the assistant know about the training?

options.text: Use a model with a huge window so last month's chat is still there
Save a training record and load that student's record with a tool
Ask the model to remember the training once the chat is over
Search the machine manuals for the student's name and training

items.stem: The assistant answers a question using retrieval over a 300-page laser cutter manual. Besides its prompt and the conversation, which part of the manual did the model read for that answer?

options.text: Only the few chunks the search returned for the question
All 300 pages, from which it picked the best page
Only the page numbers, which it then looked up itself
A copy of the manual it learned from during training

items.stem: A long assistant run has filled its context with old tool results. In one or two sentences, name one way to shrink the context, and say why simply switching to a model with a bigger window would not be the better fix.
